summary: Tura Mountain Airport serves the remote settlement of Tura, the administrative center of Russia's Evenk District in Krasnoyarsk Krai, deep in central Siberia. Positioned east of the Yenisei River, it provides essential air connectivity for an isolated subarctic region inhabited largely by indigenous Evenk communities. The airport functions as a critical lifeline in an area with virtually no road or rail infrastructure.
faqs:
Q: Where is Tura Mountain Airport located?
A: It is located in Tura, the administrative center of Evenk District in Krasnoyarsk Krai, Russia, in central Siberia at approximately 64°N
